### When Your Mess Becomes Your Message
Author: Micca Monda Campbell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-jan-25-2010-11625304.html
Passage: Jeremiah 17:14
Points:
- Human willpower alone cannot break the bonds of addiction, sin, or emotional defeat.
- True and lasting restoration occurs only when a person surrenders their life to Jesus.
- God specializes in redeeming broken lives and turning tragedy into triumph.
- Experiencing God's healing transforms past struggles into a message of hope for others.

### A Prayer of Healing for Sick Family and Friends
Author: Wendy van Eyck
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-of-healing-for-sick-family-and-friends-your-daily-prayer-february-17-2017.html
Passage: Jeremiah 17:14
Points:
- The ultimate burden of healing rests with God rather than the patient or doctor.
- Effective prayer does not require perfectly polished or eloquent phrasing.
- God's Word invites believers to pray boldly and expectantly for physical and spiritual restoration.
- Even when earthly healing is not granted, God remains completely sovereign and trustworthy.
